kind: K07 round-8 independent browser tests of the BUILD planner (city-plan-v2)
label: build_d18847f
note: Points, sites, costs and weights are placed by the test or come from SYNTHETIC files; they are not city data.

checks.expect: tool «Несколько объектов (v2)» shows the plan card and hides the v1 card
points mode: 3 clicks give P1..P3 with weight 1; the status line near the map names the mode

observed.msg: Кандидат K3 поставлен; стоимость по умолчанию 100 усл. ед. — задайте свою.

checks.expect: weights, costs, budget, max and radius are set by the inputs

checks.expect: search result (three objectives: IDs, sum, worst, coverage, cost) = the K07 calculator for the same scenario; cards manual + 3
«Применить» (Среднее) sets the manual plan to its IDs; «Вернуть ручной план» restores K1+K2
a weight change after the search drops the result (status stale, no «Применить»)

observed.optMsg: Задача изменилась — прежние оптимумы устарели. Запустите поиск снова.

checks.expect: no console or page errors on the user path
